senses.gloss: ch. same, to be quiet, at ease.—V. שֶׁפִי.

units: <cite ref="Gittin 73a:11">Gitt. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>זיל שַׁפֵּי ליה</he> go and pacify (settle with) him.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 15a:16">B. Mets. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>ואֲשׁפֵּי וכ׳</he> (Ms. H. a. R. <he>ואֵישַׁפֵּי</he>), v. <cite ref="M02761"><he>מְרַק</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מְשַׁפֵּי</he>; pl. <he>מְשַׁפָּן</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 70a:9">Ib. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>דמש׳ ניכסיה</he> (not <he>דמשפו</he>) one whose property is at peace (undisputed by any claimants).
